Hostinger AI Website Builder

Hostinger AI Website Builder generates hosted websites from prompts and packages the builder with Hostinger's hosting, domain and AI website tools.

What is Hostinger AI Website Builder?

Hostinger AI Website Builder is a hosted site-creation product for users who want to generate and publish a website without managing WordPress or server infrastructure. AI assists with the initial site, writing and visual tasks, while the commercial plans bundle hosting and website capacity under Hostinger's subscription model.

Best for: Budget-conscious individuals and small businesses that want an all-in-one hosted website builder with AI assistance.

Main features

  • AI-generated website creation
  • Visual website editing
  • AI writing and site-content tools
  • Responsive hosting and SSL
  • Domain support
  • AI credits included by plan

Use cases

  • Launch a simple small-business website
  • Create a portfolio or personal site
  • Generate a landing page from a prompt
  • Draft website copy with AI
  • Host multiple small websites on one account where the plan allows

Who is it for?

  • small businesses
  • freelancers
  • beginners
  • creators
  • budget-conscious site owners

Pricing and plans

subscription

Starting price: USD 2.99 / month equivalent on a 48-month prepaid promotional term

Advantages

  • Low promotional entry price
  • Hosting and website building are packaged together
  • A free trial/preview path is documented for building before purchase

Limitations

  • The lowest advertised monthly equivalent requires a long prepaid term
  • Renewal pricing is substantially higher than the promotional rate
  • AI credits and number of websites are capped by plan, and fair-use terms apply

Frequently asked questions

Is Hostinger AI Website Builder permanently free?

No permanent free builder plan was listed on the checked pricing page. Hostinger does, however, document a free trial experience for building and previewing before purchase.

Why is the headline monthly price so low?

The cited $2.99 monthly equivalent is promotional pricing attached to a long prepaid term. Renewal rates are higher, so the full commitment and renewal price matter.

Does Hostinger have APIs?

Yes. Hostinger publishes developer API documentation, including programmatic management of supported Hostinger services.
